frequency_question: How often do central banks successfully execute and announce emergency or supplementary liquidity absorption tools (such as incremental reserve ratios or special deposit facilities) within a designated 4-month operational window?
membership_rule: Includes any formal regulatory notification by a major emerging market central bank regarding a temporary cash reserve ratio increase or equivalent primary liquidity tightening mechanism; excludes permanent structural reserve ratio adjustments enacted as part of multi-year policy reforms.

cases.name: State Bank of Pakistan cash reserve requirement tweak 2023

provenance_note: 5 cases named, 8 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.6x)
coverage_note: 5 named cases; estimated roughly 8 major comparable emerging market instances in total over the observation period.
known_gaps: Excludes minor administrative clarifications that do not constitute primary policy tool changes.
skeleton: Total observed central bank discretionary liquidity tool deployments across selected comparable jurisdictions over a 10-year baseline.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 8 attempted discrete emergency liquidity tool implementations within tight operational windows equals 62.5%.
validity_reason: Central bank regulatory procedures and legal frameworks for emergency liquidity management typically remain stable over multi-year horizons unless major legislative overhauls occur.
